description.en: A pre-release, self-hosted monitor that checks websites and APIs, opens one incident per failure and sends signed webhooks. It runs on your own server; there is no hosted service.
description.id: Monitor self-hosted tahap pra-rilis yang memeriksa situs dan API, membuka satu insiden per kegagalan, dan mengirim webhook bertanda tangan. Dijalankan di server Anda sendiri; tidak ada layanan terkelola.
